scope: Actual React-PDF/PDF.js using shipped synthetic PDF fixtures and browser interactions, about:blank with in-memory store; no normal-origin or IndexedDB claim

checks.name: Actual PDF.js canvas loads with hidden controls and no bottom companion module
Natural single-page scroll reaches edge; slow wheel ticks advance and reverse correctly

detail.gesture: 3 x 30 pixels at 350ms intervals; no synthetic scrollTop

checks.name: One continuous momentum burst does not skip multiple physical pages
Quick PDF Spread controls one document, separately from Compare
Sidebar page headings and on-demand definitions navigate actual physical PDF pages
Workspace state save/restore retains actual PDF intra-page scroll and all session fields
All-state restore preserves two independent PDFs, pane order and collapse state
Local text preparation remains available on demand, without a reader module
On-demand metadata editing and promotion preserve PDF content and physical position
Continuous mode keeps native scrolling rather than discrete page turns
No uncaught PDF or UI errors
